claims.claim: A nonzero binary-decimic restriction with exactly five distinct projective roots cannot satisfy the frozen clean double-conic normal-layer equation det Hess(h5)=q^4 ell with ell nonzero in characteristic zero.
claims.scope_limit: Exactly five distinct support points only; no claim for six or more support points.

claims.claim: All 31 generators of the binary-decimic multiplicity-six locus lie in the radical of the frozen tangent normal-layer ideal.
claims.scope_limit: Tangent residual-quadratic orbit only; no transfer to the secant orbit is claimed.

claims.claim: The three displayed rational quartics h, h2 and h3 are successive localized-colon elements for the frozen secant chart.
claims.scope_limit: No full colon equality, saturation, or fourth-target membership is claimed.

claims.claim: Each of the sixteen prospectively selected free source columns extends to an exact rational source-module syzygy in the frozen fourth character-two Macaulay block.
claims.scope_limit: Source-kernel theorem only; it does not establish rational membership of M*h4 or any closure theorem.

claims.claim: The bundled release does not solve HC4 or JC2 and leaves the secant-orbit closure and fourth-target gates open.
